name: Valley of Dragons
description: A fantasy setting centered on the Valley of Dragons, where humans, elves, and dragons coexist and defend the valley against supernatural threats.

accepted_story_text_precedence: drive:The Valley of Dragons 1 - Attack of the Dark God v2

core_facts: Humans, elves, and dragons coexist in the Valley of Dragons.
Dragons are ancient inhabitants and natural guardians of the valley.
Elves are strongly associated with magic, knowledge, art, and living architecture.
Humans are associated with craftsmanship, trade, adaptability, and resourcefulness.
The Dragon Rider Knights are an order formed by elves and dragons to defend the valley.

source_provenance.folder: The Valley of Dragons/1 - Attack of the Dark God
